## What it is

Couvercle du boîtier de dérivation. Impression tête en bas : face extérieure sur le plateau, jupe en +Z. Deux vis M3 dans les piliers du boîtier.

## Design notes

The plate is 1.6 mm and sits on the box walls, closing the four 10 mm slots from above. A 2.5 mm skirt nests on the three walls that have no wire slots (back and both ends). The slotted wall stays clear so the dropped-in wires are not pinched.

Same inner 37 × 32 mm and 1.6 mm walls as `boitier`. Bambu Studio: export STL, not nurb 3MF.

## Don't

- Do not run a full-perimeter skirt. Slots in the jupe at the notched wall left 0.05–0.12 mm films.
- Do not U-cut or slot the skirt for the wires; omit the jupe on the slotted wall instead.
- Do not polish inner skirt edges. Same rule as the box: outer corners only.
- Do not change the lid holes to M4. Clearance is ISO 273 medium for M3 (3.4 mm).

## Changelog

- Lid for the four standing 221-423 box. XY unchanged when the box went to 25 mm; reprint the box, not this lid, after that height change.
